description: Decoding the action name of one transaction in a mutation request into the letter the sync log writes it back as. The asymmetry is deliberate and is the contract: a mutation request spells the action out (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ARCHIVE, UNARCHIVE) while the sync log uses a single letter (I, U, D, A, V). Neither spelling is accepted where the other belongs, so a port that reuses one enum for both wire formats is wrong. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.
